objectives: Montar busca semântica com top-k e limite.
Calibrar o limite com perguntas reais.
Decidir quando encaminhar para um humano.
pt.activity: Em grupos, cada um escreve 3 perguntas para o FAQ (2 do assunto, 1 fora). Testem e votem no limite que melhor separa.
discussion: Que erro custa mais no RH: responder errado ou encaminhar demais?
Que perguntas encaminhadas indicariam que falta algo no FAQ?
misconceptions: "Busca semântica sempre acha a resposta." Ela sempre acha algo; o limite diz se presta.

objectives: Build semantic search with top-k and a threshold.
Calibrate the threshold with real questions.
Decide when to hand over to a human.
en.activity: In groups, each person writes 3 questions for the FAQ (2 on-topic, 1 off). Test them and vote on the threshold that separates best.
discussion: Which mistake costs more in HR: a wrong answer or forwarding too much?
Which forwarded questions would show the FAQ is missing something?
misconceptions: "Semantic search always finds the answer." It always finds something; the threshold says if it’s useful.
